t: What Iron-Air Long-Duration Storage Batteries Is
title: What Iron-Air Long-Duration Storage Batteries Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Iron-air batteries store electricity by reversibly rusting iron: discharging oxidizes iron, charging turns rust back to metal. Using the cheapest materials on Earth, they deliver 100-hour storage at a fraction of lithium's cost — the battery for multi-day renewable lulls. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Iron-Air Long-Duration Storage Batteries: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Iron-Air Long-Duration Storage Batteries in one line: Iron-air batteries store electricity by reversibly rusting iron: discharging oxidizes iron, charging turns rust back to metal.
Why it matters: Multi-day storage needs the cheapest chemistry imaginable; rust is it..
Where it is used: multi-day grid storage, renewable firming, seasonal shifting..
